tools.name: replace_text
tools.description: Change or remove text in a photo or screenshot and keep the same font, colour and background. Give each line to change as { from, to }: "from" is the text as it appears in the image, "to" the new text (empty to remove it). Up to 20 lines per image; 1 credit per image. tools.name: scan_text
tools.description: Read every line of text in an image with its position (0 to 1000 from the top left). Free, but counts toward the scan limit. Use it to find the exact "from" text for replace_text.

tools.name: get_edit
tools.description: Status of an edit. When ready, result_url downloads the edited PNG for one hour. Free.

tools.description: Credits available on this MakeItSay account. One credit edits one image.
